>) Lab in the Department of Data and Systems Engineering at The University of Hong Kong (HKU) is recruiting outstanding students and researchers to join our newly established lab.

Our research lies at the intersection of HCI, AI, and XR, with current interests in intelligent interactive systems, multimodal and embodied AI, spatial intelligence, and human–AI interaction for XR and smart glasses.

We invite applications for:
- 1–2 fully funded PhD positions (starting in 2027)
- 1–2 fully funded postdoctoral positions (starting in 2027)

Application deadlines:
- PhD positions: 1 December 2026
- Postdoctoral positions: 1 September 2026

Applicants should have a solid background in technical HCI, AI/ML, ubiquitous computing, wearable computing and XR, or closely related fields.

For PhD applicants, HKU offers flexible admissions throughout the year, allowing students to commence on the first day of any calendar month. Exceptionally qualified candidates are strongly encouraged to apply for the HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme (HKU-PS<
>) and the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS<
>), both of which provide highly competitive financial support. Other admitted PhD students are typically supported through the Postgraduate Scholarships (PGS<

>).

For postdoctoral applicants, outstanding early-career researchers are encouraged to contact us regarding prestigious fellowship opportunities, including the RGC Junior Research Fellow (JRF<

>) scheme and the HKU Presidential Research Assistant Professor (PRAP) position.
